_comment: Support settings for a stacked Gridfinity baseplate. These now cover only the case where the slicer still generates the interface as support; the current arrangement prints the film as a model part in its own filament with support disabled entirely (see README). Pairs with a 0.6 mm gap: 0.1 mm clear of each plate and 0.4 mm of film between, which is two layers. The film must not touch the plates -- at zero clearance the slicer merges the volumes and lays down no interface filament at all. Pattern must stay concentric: it leaves 5 sub-2mm stubs where rectilinear leaves 65, and rectilinear_interlaced crashes the slicer outright at two interface layers. XY distance is the Bambu default 0.35, not the 0.8 measured earlier: 0.8 detaches the balconies from the socket walls, and a loose ribbon in an open cell makes more mess than an attached one.
